qualified_metadata_summary.interpretation: Public frozen counter/shape consistency, not an additional quality gate. Full source-offset/capacity replay belongs to the frozen evaluator and independent acceptance. Numeric/negation span preservation is not semantic arithmetic or absence proof; semantic cross-window context is not guaranteed. Greedy partition failure is not global impossibility.

context_handling.scope: Qualified summary is unavailable on unqualified runtime, even if partial catalog metadata exists. No additional quality selection, model calls or private label access.

descriptive_uncertainty.scope: Four public diagnostic development source groups, checkpoint-development/model-selection exposed; descriptive intervals do not establish fresh model holdout generalization, benchmark generalization or official rank.

native_query_component.missing_capture_scope: N0/null percentiles mean no captured valid timing records; they do not assert zero native work. Actual attempted/completed counters remain authoritative and separately retained. No throughput or end-to-end per-query claim.
native_query_component.scope: Captured native search await plus all returned-hit validation and result assembly until elapsed capture. Excludes shared fragment-catalog preparation, BGE, index initialization/insertion, reader initialization, query-before progress logging, queue and cleanup. Not pure search, complete decision or publisher latency.
